SELECT FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id LEFT JOIN store st ON c.store_id = st.id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON c.merchant_id = m.id WHERE uc.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY uc.created_at DESC, uc.id DESC LIMIT #{page.offset}, #{page.size}

SELECT uc.id, uc.coupon_id, c.name, c.discount_text, c.description, c.valid_from, c.valid_to, uc.status, uc.created_at AS claimed_at, uc.redeem_code, uc.redeemed_at, st.name AS store_name, m.name AS merchant_name FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id LEFT JOIN store st ON c.store_id = st.id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON c.merchant_id = m.id WHERE uc.user_id=#{userId} AND uc.id=#{userCouponId}
